name: Comic Sans Party
concept: The Office 97 + GeoCities 1998 + school-fete-poster universe: Comic Sans everywhere, WordArt, tiled backgrounds, Win95 bevels, marquees, blink, rainbow rules, under-construction signs and hit counters. The stage is a decoration level from 1 to 5: level 1 is a tasteful Element with Comic Sans that you could really work in, level 2 is a 1998 personal homepage, level 3 is the Word 97 desktop with WordArt, level 4 is an evil party poster and level 5 is the full hostile maximum. after-midnight is the same joke at a blacklight rave: dark, neon WordArt, starfield, still readable.

sources.title: Comic Relief (metric-compatible Comic Sans MS clone, OFL 1.1)
Comic Relief in google/fonts (v1.200, upstream commit 856315f)
Tinos (Times New Roman metric clone, via Fontsource)
css-wordart (MIT), WordArt gallery recreated in CSS
Cameron's World (GeoCities collage, visual reference only)
GifCities, Internet Archive GeoCities GIF search (reference only)
Jason Eppink: Under Construction, 322 GeoCities GIFs (reference only)
One Terabyte of Kilobyte Age (GeoCities screenshots)
WCAG 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold

limits: Comic Sans MS itself cannot be shipped (Monotype licence); it is used via local() and falls back to the bundled, metric-compatible Comic Relief, so Linux users never see the real thing but get identical line breaks.

WordArt arcs, waves and per-letter effects cannot be applied to React-owned text without breaking reconciliation; the header room name gets a CSS-only WordArt (gradient, outline, extrusion, skew) and the enhancer draws a decorative overlay copy for wave/arch shapes, keeping the real text in place and accessible.
Element Call and widget iframes only know light/dark: calls stay plain Element light (dark for after-midnight); only the frame around them is themed (Win95 window, neon frame).
Chat effects (confetti, snow) are canvases with hard-coded colours; the favicon and notification avatars are canvas-drawn in TypeScript; neither can be restyled.
Emoji stay Twemoji/system emoji; no redistributable 90s clip-art emoji font exists.
The composer placeholder can be replaced only by overriding Element's inline --placeholder with !important; the replacement text is English-only.
Whole-app filter animation (hue-rotate) in comic-unreadable repaints the entire app every frame; it is restricted to that variant and has to be measured in phase B (fallback: a blend-mode overlay).
Real GeoCities GIFs have unclear copyright; every GIF/PNG/SVG in the family is a self-made re-creation (CC0).

variants.name: Comic Sans · GeoCities

fonts.display: Comic Sans MS bold → Comic Relief Bold, Times New Roman → Tinos for timestamps

variants.motion: Animated rainbow hr on date separators, scrolling marquee topic, spinning 'email me' envelope, digging under-construction worker, 1 Hz blink on the NEW! badge. All off with reduced motion.

Room name in Comic Sans bold with a blue/purple gradient, topic as a scrolling marquee, green VT323 hit counter 'You are visitor no. 004711'
Underlined #0000EE links, visited #551A8B, room list as a web ring '<< prev | Room | next >>'
Rainbow animated hr between days, under-construction sign in empty rooms, NEW! starburst on unread rooms

Composer placeholder 'Sign my guestbook!' and a bevelled 'Submit Query' send button; 88x31 buttons ('Best viewed with Element', 'Powered by Matrix', 'Made with Notepad') at the bottom of the space rail

variants.name: Comic Sans · Unreadable
variants.tagline: Everything moves, rainbow on rainbow. Readability is explicitly NOT a goal. Seizure warning shown first.

fonts.ui: Comic Sans MS (local) → Comic Relief, with 3D rainbow extrusion
fonts.display: Impact → Anton, Chewy, Luckiest Guy (all at once)

shape.shadow: 7-step rainbow extrusion on text and boxes

variants.texture: animated psychedelic checker tile (tile-psych.gif), twinkling stars, confetti on top
variants.motion: Slow whole-app hue rotation (20 s loop, no flashes), wave-baseline room name, marquee on room names and topic, wobbling message tiles, spinning avatars, sparkle cursor trail, blinking timestamps (1 Hz). Reduced motion stops all movement but keeps the colours.
signature: Magenta text on cyan on an animated rainbow checkerboard, Comic Sans with a 7-colour 3D extrusion
Everything tilts, wobbles and scrolls: room names marquee, avatars spin, message tiles rock ±2deg
Whole UI slowly hue-rotates (20 s cycle, smooth, below WCAG flash thresholds)
Rainbow cursor with sparkle trail, NEW! starbursts on everything, under-construction signs in every empty state
A one-time WARNING dialog ('This theme moves and flashes. [I ACCEPT] [Take me back to safety]') and a permanent 'PANIC' button
